title: How to have a static list of options in menuSelect?
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js, I could not find what I was looking for which is: -- Is there any way to prevent one widget (menu) from refining categories in another widget (menuSelect). 

In my use case I want to have the list of categories in menuSelect widget to be static. --

comments.body:
Thanks @iapparatus for opening this issue. Even though, we haven't implemented that yet, [we have it in mind](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/2130).

In the meantime, I suggest you create your own menu widget widget using the [connectMenu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectMenu.html). Using it you can inject the static list of values that you want.
Since we already have an other issue tracking this need, I'll close this one for now. Thanks for your reporting it @iapparatus
